topic: v1 launch readiness gate inventories: the non-engineering gates (security audit, pricing validity, reference customer) needed before a launch milestone, with definitions and evidence standards

subtopics.scope: What a third-party security audit gate covers for an OS launch: launch-surface definition, in-scope vs deferred scope, auditor selection.
seed_queries: third party security audit acceptance criteria open source software
security audit scope of work engagement report deliverables software

subtopics.scope: Evidence standards for a security audit gate: written report freshness window, severity thresholds (zero open Critical/High), remediation plans, NDA plus release authorization, public summary with hash reference.
seed_queries: security audit report remediation plan critical high medium findings
NDA security audit findings public summary responsible disclosure

subtopics.scope: Willingness-to-pay discovery interviews as a launch gate: minimum interview counts, verbatim WTP evidence, transcript preservation.
seed_queries: willingness to pay customer discovery interviews pricing validation
customer development interviews pricing evidence B2B verbatim quotes

subtopics.scope: Paid pilot contract as pricing-validity proof: invoiced contract against a proposed tier, minimum clean-run window on customer hardware, release-version floor.
seed_queries: paid pilot program contract acceptance criteria enterprise software
pilot to production conversion paid contract deployment window

subtopics.scope: Reference-customer gate: continuous production deployment of at least 90 days on real hardware, incident thresholds, use in launch collateral.
seed_queries: reference customer requirements enterprise software case study
customer reference proof production deployment continuous uptime

subtopics.scope: Reference-call agreements: consent to be named, consent to reference calls, redaction of commercial artifacts for public evidence.
seed_queries: customer reference agreement template consent marketing use
reference call agreement enterprise customer case study consent

subtopics.scope: Incident severity ladders used as gate evidence: 4-tier classification, zero-critical windows, per-incident remediation documentation.
seed_queries: incident severity levels classification S1 S2 S3 S4 production
incident management severity matrix zero critical window SLA

subtopics.scope: Which launch gates are automatable versus require human judgment: CI-runnable engineering gates versus commercial gates, agent versus owner responsibility split.
seed_queries: release readiness checklist automation human judgment gates
go no-go launch review criteria owner responsibilities

subtopics.scope: Gate dependency chains and calendar lead time: engineering floor as prerequisite, pilot-to-reference time chain, target-date slips and re-targeting.
seed_queries: launch gate dependencies critical path product release planning
long lead time customer reference dependency launch date slip

subtopics.scope: Planning-doc evidence conventions for launch gates: refs/ artifact paths, blockers review stamps, issue tracker linking, drift correction of planning docs.
seed_queries: documentation as code evidence trail audit launch compliance
planning document drift correction review stamp versioning docs
